name: Queensland Looking after Country Grant Program

funder.name: Queensland Government (Department of the Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation)

summary: Grants of up to A$75,000 for First Nations organisations in Queensland to plan and deliver on-ground conservation work on Country, such as revegetation, habitat restoration, fire management and species monitoring.

status.quote: The successful applicants for the 2025 Looking After Country Grant Program have been announced.

applicant_types.quote: First Nations organisations are funded to engage communities in planning for and delivering on-ground conservation work on Country.

geography.quote: Seven First Nations organisations from across Queensland, including Innisfail, Chillagoe and Toowoomba have been awarded funding

access.quote: The successful applicants for the 2025 Looking After Country Grant Program have been announced.

amount.quote: provides funding of up to $75,000 to First Nations communities to care for the environmental and cultural values of Country.
